name: FusedAddRmsnorm

y.description: RMS-normalized output, same shape and dtype as hidden_states

description: Fused Add + RMSNorm. Computes hidden_states + residual, then RMS normalization. Pure PyTorch: x = hidden + residual; y = (x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)) * weight. Used in Llama, Qwen models.
